quote: Text generation systems that can accurately summarize a provided table according to users' information needs have the potential to greatly enhance data analysis and expedite the process of obtaining data insights.
We propose a new query-focused table summarization task... We construct a human-annotated table-to-text generation dataset named QTSUMM ...
We propose a new query-focused table summarization task, and construct a large-scale benchmark, QTSUMM, comprising 7,111 query-summary pairs collected in real-world situations.
We adopt following popular automated evaluation metrics: BLEU ... ROUGE ... METEOR ... BERTScore ... TAPAS-Acc ... AutoACU ...
